LanguageData.RR_Procurement_EstimateNotice: Catalog prices and supplier times are provisional planning estimates. Company USD pays for orders; it never creates silver or cargo by itself.
LanguageData.RR_Procurement_OrderInstructions: Choose a Core item, amount, and HQ stockpile. The quote snapshots its price and current stack estimate. Accepted shipments arrive as physical stacks in a nearby receiving area; assigned colonists use ordinary hauling work to move them into storage.

LanguageData.RR_Proc_CancelledCargoRemains: A cancelled order still has held cargo. No shipment was recreated or delivered.

LanguageData.RR_Proc_CatalogUnavailable: This Core item is not available in the current catalog.

LanguageData.RR_Proc_PriceOverflow: The quoted total exceeds the supported company account amount.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_TimeOverflow: The supplier schedule is outside the supported game-time range.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_OrderLimit: Procurement order IDs are exhausted for this branch.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_TooManyOpenOrders: Too many orders are awaiting delivery. Resolve existing orders before creating more.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_OrderHistoryFull: All retained order records are active, ambiguous, or need ledger review, so none can be safely archived. Resolve existing shipments before ordering more; no records were discarded.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_TooManyQuotes: Too many saved quotes are open. Accept or let an existing quote expire first.

LanguageData.RR_Proc_BranchMismatch: The saved order belongs to a different campaign branch. Payment and delivery actions are stopped.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_HeadquartersUnavailable: The company HQ map is unavailable. The paid order and its held cargo remain saved.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_CannotCancelAfterDispatch: This order can only be cancelled before supplier dispatch. Delivered and in-transit cargo remains physical.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_RefundOverflow: The branch account cannot accept the full quoted refund without exceeding its supported balance.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_CancellationPending: The order is already waiting for its stable refund receipt. It cannot dispatch while cancellation is pending.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_OrderUnavailable: That order is not present in this branch's procurement history.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_NotArrived: The supplier shipment has not reached its quoted arrival time.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_ReceivingUnavailable: No cargo moved. The stockpile route or receiving area needs attention.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_RedirectUnavailable: This completed, cancelled, or recovery-stopped order cannot change receiving stockpiles.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_ItemDefMissing: The original Core item definition is unavailable. No replacement item was created.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_StackLimitChanged: The current stack limit would exceed the bounded physical stack count. Cargo remains held; restore a workable limit before retrying.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_NoReachableStaff: No living, standing company pawn can reach the receiving route. Cargo remains held until staff or access changes.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_FilterChanged: The selected stockpile no longer accepts this item. Redirect the same order to another accepting stockpile.

LanguageData.RR_Proc_ReceivingStagingFull: No reachable empty receiving cells are available beside the selected stockpile. Existing floor cargo and held cargo remain in place.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_CargoOwnerUnavailable: The saved shipment holder is unavailable. No charge or item creation occurred.
LanguageData.RR_Proc_CargoCreateFailed: Physical cargo could not be safely assembled in shipment custody. No order charge was posted.
